subject: Re: SOC 2 recert: evidence staging, log window, and seat uplift
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@peregrine.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@peregrine.com>, security_ops@peregrine.com
Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 recert request: log window & seat uplift

Hi Evelyn,

As we get ready for our annual recert, security has one remaining ask before the control testing window: can Redwood provide a two-week staging export of audit/log data (for 2028-09 -> 2028-11) scoped to our production tenant? We also need to firm up the proposed seat uplift and contract amendment you outlined on the renewal call — legal needs the amendment to reflect a 25% increase in seat commitments and a 12-month term extension.

High level ask:
- Evidence export (staging): full ingestion logs + auth events, export manifest and SHA256 checksums
- Retention window confirmation: 18 months for Peregrine data post-termination (we flagged this in the renewal term sheet)
- Pricing & amendment: routing to your team for a draft amendment and DocuSign link

Can Redwood confirm feasibility and an ETA for the log export? Also, please indicate if the export will be a single tarball or multiple segmented archives (we prefer single, but can accept segmented).

Thanks — Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Security Operations
Peregrine Financial

--

Attachment: request_sample_manifest.json (referenced)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@peregrine.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Dec 2028 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert request: log window & seat uplift

Liam — thanks for the clear ask. We're aligned and can meet the staging export + amendment timeline with a small ops runbook and a one-time transfer job. Summary of what we'll do: 

- Evidence export: produce segmented tarball with a top-level manifest (log_export_manifest.tar.gz). File-level checksums and a short readme included.
- Scope: production tenant logs for 2028-09-01 -> 2028-11-30, includes auth events, API request/response metadata (no payload storage), and system-level error traces per SOC 2 scope.
- Retention confirmation: we will include an explicit 18-month retention clause in the amendment.
- Seat uplift & term: internal commercial review shows 25% seat uplift is supportable. Laura will price the amendment and provide a DocuSign-ready PDF.

Action items I'm committing to this week:
1) Ops: schedule export job (target window: 2028-12-05 to 2028-12-06) and provide a GCS presigned link for pickup.
2) Security: share the evidence index (SOC2_Evidence_Index.xlsx) with the Peregrine security team by EOD Monday.
3) Commercial: Laura to circulate the draft amendment and DocuSign link by Tuesday EOD.

If that works, we'll proceed. Adding Karthik and Laura here so they can confirm technical/runbook and pricing details.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

--

Attachment: SOC2_Evidence_Index.xlsx (index sheet with pointers to log buckets)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@peregrine.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@peregrine.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Dec 2028 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert request: log window & seat uplift

Evelyn / Laura — technical confirmation and a couple of clarifications from the infra side:

- Export format: we'll produce a single compressed tarball per day (so three tarballs for the requested window) and then generate a single top-level manifest that references each daily archive. This keeps chunk sizes predictable for transfer while keeping a single manifest entry point (we'll call out checksums per archive). If Peregrine still prefers one monolithic archive we can combine, but it will increase processing time and risk of partial transfer failures.
- Sensitive data note: request/response bodies are redacted in our export; we will provide metadata (headers, timestamps, request hashes) sufficient for control testing.
- Transfer: we'll stage artifacts to a GCS bucket with time-limited signed URLs (we can also SFTP if you prefer). ETA: export job will run on 2028-12-06 02:00 UTC, links shared once job completes (typically within 3–4 hours).
- Seat uplift: this is a commercial decision, but from capacity sizing perspective a 25% uplift maps to one additional Dedicated pool (2x A100 equivalent) for their production tenant. We'll include a note in the amendment that a Dedicated onramp will be provisioned within 10 business days of signature.

Next steps: Evelyn to approve the daily-archive + manifest approach with the Peregrine team. Laura — can you confirm the amendment language and the billing proration model for mid-term uplift?

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

--

Attachment: log_export_manifest.tar.gz (placeholder for manifest & checksums)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@peregrine.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@peregrine.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Dec 2028 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert request: log window & seat uplift

Liam / team — attaching the draft amendment and the commercial summary. Key points:

- Term: 12-month extension starting on signature date.
- Seat uplift: +25% seat count, billed pro-rata for the remainder of your current billing period, then annualized thereafter.
- Retention: 18-month retention clause for Peregrine customer data, plus a one-time evidence export as described.
- Onramp: provisioning for dedicated capacity within 10 business days of signed amendment.

I've uploaded the DocuSign-ready PDF here: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=example and included a Drive folder containing the evidence index and runbook for the export: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleEvidenceFolder

If you confirm, I'll send the DocuSign envelope and we'll schedule the export for 2028-12-06 02:00 UTC.

Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

--

Attachment: DocuSign_Amendment.pdf (PDF with amendment and retention clause)
